name: polaris-root
//: Deliberately NOT an npm workspace -- though the reason it could not be is gone. build:layer used to ship a Lambda layer by copying backend/node_modules wholesale, and workspace hoisting would have moved those packages to the root and deployed the layer nearly empty: a stack that reports success and then throws Cannot find module on every invocation. esbuild bundles each lambda from its own entry now and there is no layer. backend/ and webapp/ still install their own tree, and this file still only forwards scripts. The `version` above is the WHOLE REPO's, and the only one: deploy.sh ships the backend and the webapp together from one commit, and the webapp's api types are generated from backend/openapi.json at build time, so the two cannot be at different versions. Neither sub-package carries a version of its own.
